chapter: Rhythm Club, studio dates and the 1930s big bands
title: First recording with Ella Fitzgerald on a Teddy Wilson date
summary: McRae had just met Ella, not yet in Webb's band, when they cut "My Melancholy Baby" and "All My Life".

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: for. We just would go and do a recording date see. Like, if Teddy had a date or something like that. We never asked who we were recording for, whether it was for RCA Victor, or something like that.
This is your first work with Ella Fitzgerald.
That was the first time I did anything with her, yeah.
But you weren't a member of the Chick Webb --
No, I wasn't a member of the band then.
Yeah, I was surprised that she was doing this date, you know. I didn't know her well at that time. I just met her.
She was relatively new in the band at that time?
